description: This PHP source file defines the MyTimesheetAPI class, which extends EmployeeTimesheetAPI to provide API endpoints related to employee timesheets in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class customizes validation rules for operations such as creating, updating, and retrieving timesheets, including removing certain parameters and adding validation for the date parameter.

classes.name: MyTimesheetAPI
classes.description: API class handling employee timesheet operations, including validation rules for creating, updating, and fetching timesheet data.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving all timesheets, removing employee number validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a timesheet, removing default employee number and date parameters, and adding custom date validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a timesheet, removing employee number validation.
